limitation: The existing zero-history/no-rank penalty fallback reuses goal_weight. Changing ordinary goal weights can therefore also change fallback taker choices for those cases. These NP arms are not pure causal isolation of ordinary-goal allocation. This is an additional reason not to promote them; the conditional-only arm changes no scorer weights.
